messages:
devon: Hey @marta, our integration suddenly started getting 403s a few hours ago. No code changes on our side. Same API key. Example curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-REDACTED' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","input":"hi"}'
```
Response: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"Forbidden","code":"access_denied"}
```
We assumed token issue but key still works for other endpoints (embeddings) until yesterday. Any ideas?

marta: thanks, can you drop the full response body (no key) and the client region? Also, which project/account id is this under?

devon: Pasting sanitized response: 
```
{"error":{"message":"access blocked","type":"entitlement_denied","details":"plan mismatch: requested-feature=streaming, account_plan=starter"}}
```
Account: ac_63f9a. Region: us-west-2. We do use streaming heavily though never requested that feature before — it was working until last billing cycle.

omar: hi, I pulled logs for ac_63f9a around 2026-02-28 03:12 UTC. I see entitlement service returns DENIED for route /v1/generate with feature flag check streaming=true, required_plan=pro. The gateway translated that to 403. The core issue looks like plan downgrade happened on 2026-02-28 (billing failure).

eli: confirming: invoicing shows payment attempt failed on 2026-02-27 and account was auto-downgraded from pro -> starter per billing policy. There should have been email notifications but sometimes they go to billing contact only.

devon: oh — that would explain it. But why did the SDK previously return a 401 on missing/rotated keys? This 403 didn't include a clear message — customer just saw 403 and assumed auth. Can we make the error clearer?

marta: for immediate unblock, @eli can you temporarily re-enable pro for ac_63f9a or create a short-term override while they sort payment? Devon, we can also whitelist their API key for streaming for next 24h if you want. Which do you prefer?

eli: I can apply a manual temporary entitlement for 72 hours. I'll ping once done. Also adding action item to send an email to billing contact + admin if auto-downgrade happens.

sre-oncall: quick internal note: gateway currently maps entitlement_denied -> 403 with generic body {error: Forbidden}. We should include an error_code like "plan_entitlement_required" and a friendly message suggesting billing/upgrade. Created ticket INFRA-1298 to update gateway mapping and include link to billing docs.

marta: devon, while we wait for billing override, can you confirm a minimal repro that triggers the entitlement check? e.g., call with streaming param or chunked=true. If you can paste a small reproducible curl we can test after we flip the override.

devon: yes, reproduce with the same curl but add header `X-Streaming: 1`. Tried just now and still 403. Appreciate the override.

eli: manual override applied for ac_63f9a at 2026-02-28T12:03Z. Please retry, devon.

devon: retried now — success! 200 OK and streaming responses resumed. Thank you. 

marta: closing loop: next steps we committed to: 1) billing will update notification flow for auto-downgrades (eli) 2) infra will change gateway error body and map to explicit codes + docs link (sre-oncall/INFRA-1298) 3) support doc + troubleshooting checklist updated to include entitlement vs auth quickchecks (marta/omar) 4) consider a transient "grace period" auto-override for recently-downgraded accounts (product discussion).

sre-oncall: adding a note for devs — if you get a 403, check response.type or response.details for entitlement_denied or plan mismatch before assuming auth change. Also search logs for billing events within 48h.

marta: I'll follow up with devon once the billing notification changes are live. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: INFRA-1298 created by @sre-oncall — https://issues.redwood.internal/INFRA-1298

devon: appreciate the fast help. We'll sort payment on our end and keep you posted.

marta: resolved for now — marking thread resolved in support tracker.
